DomainException · ResourceNotFoundException
DuplicateResourceException · InvalidRelationshipException
GlobalExceptionHandler · ErrorResponse · ValidationErrorResponse
PageMetadata · JpaAuditingConfig · OpenApiConfig

owns no table, no aggregate, no rule
